metadata.article_title: Renewal of permits, driving licences and registration granted under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939.

article.title: Renewal of permits, driving licences and registration granted under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939.
article.content:
217A1[Renewal of permits, driving licences and registration granted under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939.

Section 217A  ·  Chapter XIV  ·  page 120 of the Act
Notwithstanding the repeal by sub-section (1) of section 217 of the enactments referred to in that sub-section, any certificate of fitness or registration or licence or permit issued or granted under the said enactments may be renewed under this Act.]
1 Ins. by Act 27 of 2000, s. 5 (w.e.f. 11-8-2000).
